collapse_expand_behavior.note: HelpTip component (HelpTip.jsx line 100) uses local React useState only — there is NO localStorage write/read for collapse state. The request's claim 'collapsed state persists (localStorage-driven)' is INACCURATE for the current implementation. This is NOT a regression; it's the as-shipped behavior. If persistence is desired, that would be a NEW enhancement (not part of iter275 scope per user directive 'do not widen scope').

duplication_check.note: Each formKey is unique on each route. Sub-section blocks (e.g. equipment-training.context) contain parent tips plus section tips — this is by backend prefix-match design; expected behavior, not duplication.

action_items: Optional / out of scope: clarify whether HelpTip collapse-state persistence across navigation is a desired enhancement. As-built, state is local to component instance — collapsing then navigating away resets to collapsed-default on re-mount. Request mentioned 'localStorage-driven' but no such code exists. If persistence is wanted, add a localStorage-backed hook keyed by `helptip-${testId}-open`.
critical_code_review_comments: HelpTipBlock fetches tips on every mount but uses a module-level _tipCache Map keyed by formKey — good. However, no auth-token-change invalidation: if a user logs in/out after first fetch, stale cached tips persist for the session. Low priority since RBAC tips per portal don't change mid-session.

HelpTip.jsx does NOT persist open/closed state. If the matrix governance requires persistence (per iter275 review_request), this is missing. Recommend adding `useState(() => localStorage.getItem(key) === '1')` + write on setOpen if persistence is a requirement.

Sub-section mounts (e.g. equipment-training.context) render the parent's 4 canonical tips alongside the section's own tips because backend prefix-matches. UX-wise this means a user scrolling down sees the same 4 'why/who/next/escalate' family repeated above each section. Confirm with product whether this echo is intentional or whether section blocks should filter out parent tips.
